data.title: ErieView Development Closes $218 Million in Financing for W Cleveland at Erieview Tower
data.description: ErieView Development has recently secured funding amounting to $218 million for the conversion of Erieview Tower in Cleveland. This iconic 40-story building, constructed in 1964, will be transformed into the W Cleveland hotel, which will feature 210 rooms, making it the first W Hotel in Ohio. Additionally, the building will offer 215 W Apartments for rent, marking the brand's first rental residential project globally. The projected opening for the hotel and residences is set for late 2027. This development boasts an extensive amenity program, promising a luxurious living experience for residents and guests alike.

data.title: Ameribrands Acquires Randal Retail Group, Expanding National Design, Manufacturing and Installation Capabilities
data.description: Ameribrands, based in Ball Ground, Georgia, a diversified company serving various sectors including restaurant, retail, hospitality, entertainment, education, and facilities, has acquired Randal Retail Group. Randal Retail Group is a prominent provider of retail design, fixture manufacturing, merchandising displays, and installation services. Through this acquisition, Ameribrands enhances its retail capabilities and progresses towards establishing a premier national platform.

data.title: Viridian Metals Announces Closing of Non-Brokered Private Placement and Market Making Agreement with Independent Trading Group
data.description: Viridian Metals has recently finalized the closure of a non-brokered private placement. The company also established a market making agreement with Independent Trading Group. This move enables Viridian Metals to raise significant funds for its operations. The private placement saw a total investment of approximately $2 million from various investors. This strategic partnership with Independent Trading Group is expected to enhance the market presence and liquidity of Viridian Metals' shares.

data.title: Questor Technology Reports Progress on Execution of Phase III Shareholder Value Creation Plan
data.description: On September 4, 2026, Questor Technology Inc. provided an update on its Phase III shareholder value creation plan, following its announcement on August 17, 2026. The company, listed on the TSX-V as QST, has made significant advancements as part of its strategy refresh during a management transition in Q2 2026. Questor's rental fleet is prepared for use, with commercial operations progressing in North America, Africa, and the Middle East. Additionally, a key partnership in Mexico is paving the way for a potential enterprise-wide contract with Pemex. These developments signify promising growth opportunities for Questor Technology Inc.

data.title: Sass Magazine Celebrates Release of 2026 LOCAL Issue

data.title: Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to Present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference
data.description: In a press release on September 4, 2026, Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc. data.title: Powder River Crude Services, LLC Announces Open Season
data.description: In Irving, Texas on September 4, 2026, Powder River Crude Services, LLC revealed the commencement of a binding open season to secure commitments for backing a new gathering pipeline system, starting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time on the same day. data.title: Midea SMART MASTER at IFA 2026: From AI Agents to Embodied Intelligence
data.description: In Berlin on September 4, 2026, Midea highlighted SMART MASTER at the forefront of its presentation at IFA 2026. Embodying the theme "Simply ideal", Midea's SMART MASTER serves as an AI-driven home system designed to establish a responsive and intuitive smart home environment.

data.title: HII Details Strategy to Increase Shipbuilding Pace for U.S. Navy
data.description: On September 4th, 2026 in Santa Clarita, California, the Executive Vice President of Maritime Systems and Corporate Strategy at HII, Eric Chewning, reiterated the company’s dedication to enhancing the nation’s defense industrial base and rejuvenating U.S. shipbuilding. This statement was made during a field hearing by the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Defense at the College of the Canyons. Chewning emphasized the significance of a modernized workforce, improved shipyard infrastructure, and a larger maritime industrial base during his address to Subcommittee Chairman Rep. Ken Calvert and other subcommittee members. HII's commitment to these goals was reiterated as a crucial strategic objective.

data.title: Laird Superfood Appoints Mark Johnson as Chief Financial Officer
data.description: In Boulder, Colorado, Laird Superfood, Inc. (NYSE American: LSF) has appointed Mark Johnson as the Chief Financial Officer, starting from October 1, 2026. Reporting directly to CEO Jason Vieth, Johnson will take on the roles of the principal financial officer and principal accounting officer for the company. With over 25 years of experience in finance leadership within public consumer packaged goods and private equity-backed firms, Johnson's arrival from a previous position brings significant expertise to Laird Superfood.
